name: sentry-cli
description: ɳSentry operations: monitors, incidents, status pages, alerts, cloud login, and provisioning a self-hosted sentry server.
author: nself

actions.status: Show instance status; exits non-zero on an unhealthy instance

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin. It provides TWO commands, `nself sentry` and `nself sentry-server`, declared in cliCommands; the installer publishes nself-sentry and nself-sentry-server into ~/.nself/plugins/bin/ where ProxyCommand execs them. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11. `nself mcp` keeps its ɳSentry MCP tools and its own copy of the API client, because mcp is a core command and plugin-contributed MCP tools do not exist yet. `nself sentry-server provision` chains into `nself build` and `nself start`, so it needs the nself CLI on PATH. The plugin is named sentry-cli rather than sentry because the paid ɳSentry bundle already answers to `nself install sentry`, and a bundle wins that lookup. binaryName and cliCommands keep the commands working as `nself sentry` and `nself sentry-server`.

cliCommands.name: sentry
cliCommands.description: Manage ɳSentry monitors, incidents, status pages and alerts

cliCommands.name: sentry-server
cliCommands.description: Provision and manage a self-hosted ɳSentry server
